body:
# EasyCommand

**可视化 Minecraft 命令编辑器** — 让小白玩家也能轻松自定义原版命令。

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-brightgreen)](https://minecraft.net)
[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-orange)](https://fabricmc.net/)

## 功能

- 🎨 **可视化 GUI** — 所有命令参数都通过图形界面选择，无需记忆复杂语法
- 📋 **25 条常用命令** — give/effect/gamemode/tp/summon/kill/enchant 等
- 🔍 **智能搜索** — 按名称或分类快速找到命令
- 🎯 **目标选择器** — @a/@e/@p/@r/@s 及过滤参数可视化配置
- 📦 **物品/方块/实体浏览器** — 从注册表直接选择，支持搜索
- ✨ **附魔编辑器** — 可视化选择附魔类型和等级
- 🔊 **音效/粒子浏览器** — 滚动搜索所有注册音效和粒子
- 💾 **预设系统** — 保存常用命令配置，一键复用
- 📜 **历史记录** — 自动记录所有执行过的命令

## 安装

1. 安装 [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) (0.19.3+)
2. 安装 [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. 将 `easycommand-0.2.jar` 放入 `.minecraft/mods/` 文件夹

## 使用

1. 在游戏中按 **K** 键打开命令编辑器
2. 从左侧分类选择命令，或搜索命令名称
3. 可视化调节各参数
4. 点击 **执行** 发送命令，或 **保存预设** 供后续使用

## 平台

| 项目 | 详情 |
|------|------|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Mod Loader | Fabric |
| Java | 21+ |
| 类型 | 纯客户端 |

## 构建

```bash
./gradlew build
```
输出：`build/libs/easycommand-0.2.jar`

## 作者

**REALIKUN2024**

# EasyCommand

**Visual Minecraft Command Editor** — making vanilla commands accessible to all players.

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-brightgreen)](https://minecraft.net)
[![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mod%20Loader-Fabric-orange)](https://fabricmc.net/)

## Features

- 🎨 **Visual GUI** — All command parameters are configured through a graphical interface — no need to memorize complex syntax
- 📋 **25 Common Commands** — give/effect/gamemode/tp/summon/kill/enchant and more
- 🔍 **Smart Search** — Quickly find commands by name or category
- 🎯 **Target Selectors** — Visual configuration of @a/@e/@p/@r/@s and filter parameters
- 📦 **Item/Block/Entity Browser** — Select directly from the registry, with search support
- ✨ **Enchantment Editor** — Visually select enchantment types and levels
- 🔊 **Sound/Particle Browser** — Scroll and search all registered sounds and particles
- 💾 **Preset System** — Save frequently used command configurations for one-click reuse
- 📜 **History** — Automatically records all executed commands

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) (0.19.3+)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Place `easycommand-0.2.jar` into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder

## Usage

1. Press **K** in-game to open the command editor
2. Select a command from the category list on the left, or search by name
3. Adjust parameters visually
4. Click **Execute** to send the command, or **Save Preset** for later use
